sources.quote: QS-C-2025,SUP-C,conditional,2025-04-01,,PER-BIANCHI,QS-C-2023,no new parts until 8D-25-031 is closed and re-audit passed
4.3 A supplier with status conditional may not receive new parts.

findings.why: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C) is conditional under QS-C-2025, which replaced QS-C-2023. BR-225 would be a new part for it, and 8D-25-031 is still open.

sources.quote: 4.2 A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that

findings.why: The approved supplier list covers BR-225 at PLT-BEI for CUST-AUR, and the only approval is for SUP-B. SUP-C has no approval for BR-225 at PLT-BEI for Aurelia. The only SUP-C approvals are for BR-180 and BR-310.

sources.quote: 7.1 The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
7.3 Approval is granted per part number and per manufacturing site.

findings.why: BR-225 belongs to PRG-X, which is an Aurelia program. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual replaces revision 3 and requires written approval (PPAP) for a change of source. Nothing in force covers this change. Revision 4 also requires 90 days' notice.

sources.quote: Supplier: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C). Opened 2025-03-20. Status: open.
cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by

findings.why: SUP-C has an open 8D on EN AW-6082 material. BR-225 is made of EN AW-6082-T6, which is a temper of that alloy.

sources.quote: SC-BR225-YS,BR-225,Yield strength Rp0.2 at least 250 MPa,250

findings.why: The drawing requires MAT-6082-T6. SUP-C is qualified only for MAT-6061-T6 and MAT-6082-T5, not MAT-6082-T6. The material master gives a typical yield of 230 MPa for 6082-T5 and 240 MPa for 6061-T6, both below the 250 MPa minimum of the special characteristic.

sources.quote: 4.4 A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for

findings.why: The certificate register has no 3.1 certificate for SUP-C for any material, so none exists for MAT-6082-T6. The supplier quality engineer (E. Gallo) needs to answer this.
